notes: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Hidden flags come from the same lists (planetgta6.com cross-check: 27 visible, 28 hidden). Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its source, and each trophy carries a 'when' note saying the earliest point it can be earned. PowerPyx is the main guide source.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
planetgta6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements

roadmap.title: Play the story (Chapters 1–5)
roadmap.text: Finish the story first. The 100% checklist stays hidden until after the story, but everything you do during it already counts toward it. There are no mission gold medals and no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter. One thing matters in Chapter 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only trophy you can miss.

roadmap.title: Side stories
roadmap.text: Finish the optional questlines — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret — and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. All of them stay open after the story, so do them as they appear or clean them up in free-roam.

roadmap.title: World & activities
roadmap.text: Stunts, shooting ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, WAiNK scans, card sets, meditations, vehicles, animals, robberies and money. Most of these count toward the 100% checklist, so work them together instead of one at a time.

roadmap.title: 100% cleanup & platinum
roadmap.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and finish what is left — any 70 of 80 challenges, the remaining collectibles and robberies. A Long Road (100%) is the last trophy for most players; the platinum pops right after it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies — there are no online or DLC trophies, so a single playthrough covers the lot. For most players the last one to pop is A Long Road (100% completion); the platinum follows the moment it does. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops at the end of the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 1 closes when you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 2 closes when you start the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 3 closes after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 4 closes after its final main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable (gold). It pops after the final mission, Starting From Zero — the same mission that closes Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and usually the last. Once the story is done, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The bar is forgiving — about 60% of true completion: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals with the binoculars, and finish any 70 of 80 challenges. Only Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests need every item. Story progress already counts, and nothing toward 100% can be missed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts; 100% needs 300. Four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps — mix them freely, so take the fastest route: flying under bridges. Track by region at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt has its own name and stays marked once done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), playing a Video Game, winning a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race, and performing a Stunt. Check them at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most happen on their own through the story and the other trophies; activities show as blue dumbbell icons once you unfog the map.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 ranges. The golds are forgiving — take your time, aim for the headshot targets, and use a steady weapon. All 42 also sit on the 100% checklist, so this one lands on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. Every one is also on the 100% checklist, so it lands while you work toward A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 14 Top Fun Drone Race Locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from 40 unique race locations. Any race type counts, but winning the same race twice still counts once — you need 20 distinct wins.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 40 Unique Race Locations

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the 4 arcade games (Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home from Chapter 1, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. You must clear every level in it at least once — clearing every challenge is not required. Pick the one you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline, Lucia only. It opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van) and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). Every quest stays open after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline, marked in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls; find him at the green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks treasure chests on the map — clear 7 shipwrecks, diving with a metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet in later chapters and returns in Chapters 2–3 as Jason (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up). Track it at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline, marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist Smash Grab (Join Billy on a Job), Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job), The Impaler (Steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job). All stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more strangers still being found. All stay open after the story in free-roam; watch your count in the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 — after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, marked after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants; track them at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and find him at the green RK icon in west Vice City. Use the WAiNK app to check whether a car is on the list; the cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, often parked outside hotels. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline, Jason only, marked after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs at the purple map markers in Vice City (quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. Everything stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2. Track at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the first meditation is at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is unclear whether it counts, so do it. The last meditation needs both characters together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). For 100% only 15 of 18 are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline, Jason only, marked after Chapter 2: Coffee Break by a text from Bret (quest Veteran Hunted — meet Bret in Lummox County). He marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him as Jason. His first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Track at Map > Activities > Target Deck — 15 Target Decks, all 15 needed for 100%. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida; each set is a group of cards found in the world, and any 3 finished sets pop the trophy.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 18 Collectible Card Set Locations

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). There are more than 100 scannable spots — 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags — and any 100 count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this pops on the way — 10 more challenges exist than needed, so pick the easiest. Track them at Progress > Challenges; many finish on their own while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, once you can free-roam with both characters — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then get out of the red heat zone: a fast sports bike weaving through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) shakes the cops and the helicopter easily. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and while robbing the 8 large bank vaults for 100%.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2: Coffee Break, with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level — the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): loot the items and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after you leave the 3rd shop — hit a 4th shop if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 of the 557 vehicles (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Use the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly, then hold R1 to scan a vehicle. Just stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; you never need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this comes on its own. Track at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots). Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (L1 + Triangle) to stretch it, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a Gang Operation and drop them without missing. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raise it through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; you will likely reach level 4 on your own.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not one parked on the airfield. Easiest at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base — drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.when: Chapter 4 — after That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults (all 8 are needed for 100%). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a bag (hold Right to hand one off). Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips — after his Payday Loans quests — and he marks vans with purple icons. Robbing a vault means an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles. Up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops on its own in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani becomes a fence after Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 How to Unfog the Map Fast

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and all 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. They show as yellow icons on the map when you go near them; track them at Progress > Gangs, where each gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Illegal Gang Operation Locations

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown — no confirmed method yet. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so check the beach bars once more guides land. This entry says so honestly instead of guessing.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (listed as unknown)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.when: Chapter 3 — after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Only the blue Banshee works — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III — and the pop is slightly delayed, after you drive further down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway — blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, and you do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so come back for what you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Open after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one character works out, the other trains on its own, so you make double progress. Filter clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that shape your criminal profile — see the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and switch on criminal-profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications (a demon face appears whenever you do something that affects your reputation). Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitate without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) to Irredeemable (permanent — cops shoot on sight). It comes passively from robberies and fights; farm it by running over civilians and cops if needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. No confirmed method yet — this entry says so honestly instead of guessing.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (listed as unknown)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown, believed to come from a UFO questline. No confirmed method yet — this entry says so honestly instead of guessing.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (listed as unknown)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by). No confirmed method yet — this entry says so honestly instead of guessing.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (listed as unknown)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It counts cumulatively across all robberies, not $250,000 at once; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they cost the most. Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related; the 8 cost $160,000 in total). Garages open after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through it. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
